authority: PI, 2026-08-31: reopen latent work for ONE bounded H-OG-PSP experiment, run in parallel with the SAPPO manuscript
name: Heterogeneous Oracle-Gated Paired Specialist Preservation (H-OG-PSP)

THE_HYPOTHESIS.statement: Complementary latent strategies require BOTH latent-private actor capacity AND supervision at the trajectory level. OG-PSP supplied neither and produced action differentiation without strategic separation.
two_components: z must control actor PARAMETERS, not merely enter actor INPUTS
specialist identity must be reinforced over TRAJECTORIES, not only individual states
THE_HYPOTHESIS.why_now: Both components are licensed by evidence obtained after OG-PSP's verdict was frozen, not by dissatisfaction with it.

WHAT_PRIOR_WORK_ALREADY_ELIMINATED.reading: Six candidate explanations are closed. The two this spec addresses are what remain.

COMPONENT_1_LATENT_PRIVATE_ACTOR_CAPACIT.mechanism: V6I26 LRO deep branches: each latent owns a private 2-layer trunk (Linear(H,H)->ReLU->Linear(H,H)->ReLU) plus a private action head Linear(H, action_dim).
COMPONENT_1_LATENT_PRIVATE_ACTOR_CAPACIT.why_fixed_alpha_not_gated: rl/latent_marl.py:339-343 -- fixed-alpha uses Kaiming init deliberately. Zero-init adapters cannot accumulate gradient signal and form a zero-gradient degenerate equilibrium. This was the V6I22E root cause and must not be reintroduced.
COMPONENT_1_LATENT_PRIVATE_ACTOR_CAPACIT.why_not_adapters: V6I22 ran adapter-based repertoire birth and reached behavior_pair_dist 0.033 against a 0.06 bar. Adapters alone did not deliver behavioral separation. This spec deliberately picks a substantially stronger structural mechanism.
COMPONENT_1_LATENT_PRIVATE_ACTOR_CAPACIT.honest_status_of_this_code: The mechanism is IMPLEMENTED AND EXERCISED, but in a different experimental context -- V6I26 targeted weakness-driven branch birth against niche opponents on map_b and OP8-12. It has NEVER been used as the private-capacity substrate for OG-PSP paired supervision on map_a Pole A/B. It is untested HERE, not untested code.
COMPONENT_1_LATENT_PRIVATE_ACTOR_CAPACIT.exactly_one_mechanism: FiLM, z-adapters, and z-onehot remain DISABLED. Stacking mechanisms would make a result unattributable, which is the two-axes problem OG-PSP already carries.

COMPONENT_2_TEACHER_GROUNDED_TRAJECTORY_.mechanism: A discriminator D(tau) -> {A, B} trained ONCE on frozen SAPPO specialist trajectories, then held FIXED. During training, z0 rollout segments are encouraged toward A-classification and z1 segments toward B.
COMPONENT_2_TEACHER_GROUNDED_TRAJECTORY_.feature_map: IDENTICAL to the frozen probe: per-agent obs_vec mean and std plus action histogram, 128 dims. Reused unchanged so the training signal is the same quantity the probe validated at 0.95/0.97.

the_discriminator_is_frozen.rule: D is trained on teacher trajectories and never co-adapted with the policy.
the_discriminator_is_frozen.why: A co-adapted discriminator can be satisfied by arbitrary difference. We have a direct counterexample in our own data: OG-PSP's z1 achieved a +10.0 pp crossed gap and converted it to exactly zero payoff advantage. Freezing D to teacher-defined identity is what ties diversity to strategies of proven strategic value.
the_discriminator_is_frozen.anchors: ROMA's explicit identifiability and DGPO's performance-aware diversity

COMPONENT_2_TEACHER_GROUNDED_TRAJECTORY_.task_reward_stays_primary: lambda_traj is bounded so the auxiliary cannot dominate PPO. A policy must not be able to win the auxiliary objective by behaving strangely.
prohibited: any objective rewarding difference not grounded in teacher identity
training D on the policy's own rollouts

PRESERVED_UNCHANGED_FROM_OG_PSP.paired_state_level_rehearsal: (s,z0)->pi_A(s) AND (s,z1)->pi_B(s) on every resolved state, mean aggregation, ties get zero pressure. This is validated and is NOT the thing being changed.
PRESERVED_UNCHANGED_FROM_OG_PSP.bank: the existing 1,804-state bank; NO new collection campaign
PRESERVED_UNCHANGED_FROM_OG_PSP.budget: 1,000,000 steps, same as V1 and OG-PSP, so budget is not a confound
PRESERVED_UNCHANGED_FROM_OG_PSP.poles: Pole A = OP6 + SDS2_A_payoff_INIT_3 overlay; Pole B = OP7

THE_HARD_WALL.rule: V3 gets to improve the paper. It does not get to endanger the paper.
THE_HARD_WALL.icra_deadline: 2027 submissions due 2026-09-15 23:59 PST, 8 pages including references, no planned extension
THE_HARD_WALL.manuscript_starts_immediately: SAPPO-centered ICRA manuscript work begins today, in parallel, independent of V3 status

engineering_timebox.budget: approximately 48 hours to reach a VERIFIED LAUNCHABLE TREATMENT
engineering_timebox.if_exceeded: PARK V3 until after ICRA and commit fully to SAPPO. This is a default, not a judgement call to be relitigated.

THE_HARD_WALL.scope_limit: Exactly ONE experiment. There is no V4 under any outcome.
THE_HARD_WALL.if_v3_fails: HOG_PSP_V3_CROSSOVER_NOT_CONFIRMED is recorded and the SAPPO paper proceeds with the compression-limit finding as the centerpiece. The fallback story is already complete and does not depend on V3.

SEQUENCE: freeze this spec (done at commit time)
implement private capacity + frozen trajectory discriminator
MECHANISM SMOKE -- must pass before any 1M run
separate PI decision to open EVAL
MECHANISM_SMOKE_MUST_PROVE: updating z0 moves z0's private trunk and head and does NOT move z1's private parameters
the frozen trajectory discriminator is actually invoked during training (a runner-accessor tripwire, since a silently dead runner already nearly cost a full 1M run twice)
D's parameters do NOT change during PPO
paired rehearsal still emits both latent targets per state
legacy one-sided rehearsal path remains at 0 invocations
rollout z->pole assignment remains 32/32 with 0 mismatches

KNOWN_RISKS_RECORDED_BEFORE_THE_RESULT.two_components_change_at_once: Private capacity and trajectory supervision are introduced together. A success cannot be attributed to either alone. This is accepted deliberately because the timebox does not permit an ablation, and it is recorded now so it cannot be quietly omitted later.
KNOWN_RISKS_RECORDED_BEFORE_THE_RESULT.discriminator_transfer: D is trained on TEACHER trajectories and applied to STUDENT rollouts. Its 0.95/0.97 accuracy is on teacher data; accuracy on student trajectories is unknown and may be much lower.
KNOWN_RISKS_RECORDED_BEFORE_THE_RESULT.segment_length: The probe validated D on full episodes. Applying it to shorter training segments may weaken the signal. Segment length is a design parameter, not a validated one.
KNOWN_RISKS_RECORDED_BEFORE_THE_RESULT.prior_negative_on_related_capacity: V6I22's adapter result and the K2V2 specialist failure both bear on whether private capacity delivers separation.

PROHIBITED: re-scoring, re-seeding, or reinterpreting OG-PSP's frozen verdict
extending the timebox by relitigating the hard wall
